scenario: A registered source runs a controlled ingestion cycle, records a provenance-backed observation, routes a signal inbox item, deduplicates repeated snapshots, records health state, and can replay from a snapshot.
hold_boundaries: No live scraping or API connector is activated by this fixture.
No external commercial action is performed by the runtime.
Paid licensed sources remain HOLD until license metadata and cost controls exist.
Manual-only sources cannot start automated ingestion.
